title: Add video download, like, comment, channel naming, and quality selection features

requirements.summary: Add download button to video player page that allows users to download the video file they are currently viewing
acceptanceCriteria: Download button is visible on the video player page
Clicking the download button triggers a file download of the video
Downloaded video maintains original filename and format

file_operations.description: Add download button that uses the ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() method to create a download link for the current video. The button should be positioned near the video controls and trigger a download using an anchor element with the download attribute set to the video title as filename.

requirements.summary: Implement like functionality for videos that allows users to like videos and displays the total like count
acceptanceCriteria: Like button is visible on video player page and video cards
Users can click to like/unlike a video
Like count is displayed next to the like button
Like state persists across page refreshes
Backend stores like data associated with each video and user

file_operations.description: Create React mutation hook for liking videos that calls the backend likeVideo method and invalidates both the videos list and individual video queries to refresh like counts. Include error handling for unauthorized users.

Add like button with heart icon that displays the current like count from video.likeCount. Integrate the useVideoLike hook to handle like actions. Show authentication prompt if user is not logged in. Position the like button prominently near the video metadata.

Add like count display showing video.likeCount with a heart icon at the bottom of each video card. Make the display read-only on cards (clicking the card navigates to the player where users can like).

requirements.summary: Add comment system for videos that allows users to post comments and view all comments on a video
acceptanceCriteria: Comment section is visible below video player
Users can write and submit new comments
All comments for a video are displayed in chronological order
Each comment shows the commenter's principal and timestamp
Backend stores comments with video ID, user principal, text, and timestamp

file_operations.description: Create React Query hook that fetches comments for a specific video ID using the backend getComments method. Return an array of comments with loading and error states.

Create React mutation hook for adding comments that calls the backend addComment method with videoId and content. On success, invalidate the comments query to refresh the list. Include error handling for unauthorized users.

Create comment section component that displays all comments for a video using the useComments hook. Show each comment with author principal, timestamp formatted as relative time, and content text. Include a comment input form with textarea and submit button that uses the useAddComment hook. Show authentication prompt if user is not logged in. Display comments in chronological order (oldest first).

Import and render the CommentSection component below the video metadata section, passing the current videoId as a prop. Position it after the description to create a natural flow from video content to user interactions.

requirements.summary: Allow users to set and edit a custom channel name instead of displaying their principal, with support for shorter custom names
acceptanceCriteria: Users can set a custom channel name in their profile or settings
Channel name is displayed instead of principal on video cards, photo cards, and player pages
Users can edit their channel name at any time
Backend stores channel name associated with user principal
Channel name has a maximum character limit for shorter names

file_operations.description: Create React Query hook that fetches the channel name for a given user principal using the backend getChannelName method. Include caching with principal as query key.

Create React mutation hook for setting the channel name that calls the backend setChannelName method. On success, invalidate relevant queries including user profile and channel name cache. Include validation for maximum character limit.

Create reusable component that accepts a Principal and displays the user's channel name using the useChannelName hook. Show a loading state while fetching. If no channel name exists, display a truncated version of the principal (first 8 chars + ... + last 4 chars).

Create modal component for initial profile setup that prompts authenticated users without profiles to enter their name and optional channel name. Use the authorization component's saveCallerUserProfile method with the channelName field included in the UserProfile. Show validation for channel name character limit (max 30 characters). Display on first login when getCallerUserProfile returns null.

Create settings page with form for editing user profile including name and channel name fields. Pre-populate with current values from getCallerUserProfile. Use useSetChannelName hook for channel name updates and saveCallerUserProfile for profile updates. Include character counter showing remaining characters for channel name (max 30). Require authentication to access.
Add route registration for the new Settings page at path /settings. Include the route in the router configuration alongside existing routes.

Add Settings link to the navigation menu that appears when user is authenticated. Position it near the user profile or in a user menu dropdown. Also conditionally render the ProfileSetupModal component when user is authenticated but has no profile.
Replace the direct principal display with the ChannelNameDisplay component, passing video.uploader as the principal prop. This will show the channel name instead of the raw principal.
Replace the direct principal display with the ChannelNameDisplay component, passing photo.uploader as the principal prop. This will show the channel name instead of the raw principal.
Replace the direct principal display in the uploader metadata section with the ChannelNameDisplay component, passing video.uploader as the principal prop.
Replace the direct principal display in the uploader metadata section with the ChannelNameDisplay component, passing photo.uploader as the principal prop.

requirements.summary: Add video quality selector to video player that allows users to choose playback quality for online viewing
acceptanceCriteria: Quality selector control is visible in video player interface
Users can select from available quality options (e.g., 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p)
Video playback adjusts to selected quality
Selected quality preference is maintained during playback session

file_operations.description: Create video quality selector component that renders a dropdown or button group with quality options (Auto, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p). Use local state to track selected quality. Apply the selected quality to the video element by adjusting the playback quality property if supported by the browser, or display info message that quality selection is limited by browser capabilities. Style to match video player controls aesthetic.

Integrate the VideoQualitySelector component into the video player interface, positioning it near the video controls (bottom-right or top-right corner). Pass necessary props to control the video element's quality settings. Maintain selected quality in component state for the current playback session.
